item.title: Nordstrom: Steady but Always Evolving: Reflections on Foreign Exchange Market Structure
item.speaker: Nordstrom
item.bank: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

rating.summary: Anna Nordstrom, Head of the New York Fed's Markets Group, delivered opening remarks at the 2026 FX Market Structure Conference. Her remarks focused on FX market resilience amid global uncertainty, the accelerating adoption of AI and settlement technologies in FX markets, and the upcoming strategic review of the FX Global Code. No monetary policy stance or interest rate guidance was offered.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is entirely focused on FX market structure, technology, and governance topics rather than monetary policy. It contains no discussion of interest rates, inflation, employment, or the Fed's policy trajectory.
key_quotes: The FX market has remained resilient in the face of great uncertainty in the global economy and financial markets over the past year.
The structure of this market must rest on a strong foundation that can be both durable enough to provide stability, but also flexible enough to evolve.
